withheld.jp: 「で、私たちの放送部でも番組を作ってみないかということになって……ほら、群青っていい噂ないじゃないですか。で、少しでもそういった世情を緩和できたらという……」
withheld.en: Misato: "And so, I have decided that our Broadcast Club will be taking care of producing a radio program... you see, are there not some bad rumors going around Gunjou? And so, if it can relax people's opinion of it even just a little..."
comments: This sounds so little like Misato. This sort-of contradicts CCC0022, where the people of the city seem intent on doing this, rather than Gunjou with the administration to assuage the populace. -GHS

withheld.jp: 見里は語る。
withheld.en: Misato speaks,

withheld.jp: 身振り手振りをばたばたと可愛らしくまじえて。
withheld.en: adorably mixing in flapping gesticulation.
comments: See CCC3004, however, as well as CCC0015B. Those are seemingly the last leftovers of this part of her character. -GHS

withheld.jp: その動作で、美乳は揺れたり傾いたり寄ったり離れたり変形したり切ない風に身をよじらせたり童女のような無邪気さで跳ね回ったり淑女のようになったり娼婦のようになったりした。
withheld.en: With those motions her beautiful boobs swayed and drooped and came close and grew distant and warped and twisted her flesh around in painful ways and leaped about with the innocence of a little girl and became like a lady's and became like a harlot's.
comments: Somewhere in Japan, Team Ninja is smiling. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「ぐうぐう」
withheld.en: Sakuraba: "Zzz... zzz..."

withheld.jp: 桜庭は寝ていた。
withheld.en: Sakuraba was sleeping.
comments: Impotence more than hypnotism here. -GHS

withheld.jp: 友貴は唇の端から泡を。
withheld.en: Bubbles came from the edge of Tomoki's lips.
comments: See CCA0027. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「ふやふや～」
withheld.en: Taichi: "Softy softy~."
comments: "Fuyafuya" is an actual adjective, on the dictionary and all. Japanese is creepy, hold me. -GHS

withheld.jp: 太一は唇の端からヨダレを。
withheld.en: From the edge of Taichi's lips came drool.

withheld.jp: 「エロ猿！」
withheld.en: Touko: "You monkey in heat!"
comments: See CCA0027 -GHS

withheld.en: Taichi: "Goh-?!"

withheld.jp: 冬子が太一を殴る。
withheld.en: Touko punched Taichi,

withheld.jp: 一本拳だった。
withheld.en: with the exact knuckletip of a fist.
comments: See CCA0009B. So that's where Miki copied it from... -GHS

withheld.jp: 「……というそれはもうゴイスな計画が……」
withheld.en: Misato: "...so in short, this is a Going Suzui! of a Project and..."
comments: See CCA0003. -GHS

withheld.jp: 「……って、どうしました？　桐原さん？」
withheld.en: Misato: "...wait, what happened? Kirihara-san?"

withheld.jp: 素っ気なく冬子は顔を伏せた。
withheld.en: Touko curtly turned her face away.

withheld.jp: 人付き合いは苦手なのだ。
withheld.en: Socializing with others is a weak spot for her.

withheld.jp: そんなぎこちない冬子の態度を、内心微笑ましく思いながら、太一は気絶した。
withheld.en: And while thinking this awkward manner of Touko's as charming inside his mind, Taichi lost consciousness.

withheld.jp: そして目が覚めて。
withheld.en: And then he was awake.
comments: This part is incomprehensible on its face: no way Misato and the rest would let him lay on the ground for who knows how long. The above was a flashback, and this is reality. The question now becomes whether CCA0030 was the same or simply a recycled troll. -GHS

withheld.jp: 黒須太一は一人だった。
withheld.en: Kurosu Taichi was alone.

withheld.jp: ホコリをはらい、帰宅した。
withheld.en: dusted himself off, and headed back home.
